parts.text: Render a compact launch-readiness dashboard that compares ADK, AG-UI, and A2UI status. Include metrics, a checklist, and one primary action.

property.description: The agent calls the injected A2UI render tool rather than answering only in text.
The rendered surface uses catalogId https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/basic_catalog.json and valid v0.9 component objects with component fields.
The surface does not use prohibited type fields, lowercase component names, box, metric, checklist, title, or default catalog id.
After rendering, the agent calls remember_surface with a concise brief and surface name, then keeps chat text short.
